label: WaterMelonControl
description: WaterMelonControl adds Karoo data page widgets for sideloaded media apps, including now playing, playback controls, tap-to-open, and device music volume control.
releaseNotes:
### Stable 1.3.6

- Promotes Karoo 2 / K2 Android 8 media-control fallbacks from beta02.
- Adds Android 8-only media-key dispatch path for play/pause/next/previous.
- Keeps passive Bluetooth AVRCP and legacy media broadcast fallbacks for K2 metadata where the device exposes them.
- Keeps Karoo 3 on the optimized MediaSession path with no polling and no diagnostic logging.
- Known K2 limitation: the PLAYING widget may not show title/artist when Karoo 2 does not expose notification or media-session metadata.
